annotations.title: Read or grant an encrypted app's key

description: An ENCRYPTED miniapp's key (publish_app encrypt:true). action "get" (default): the version's key {key, key_sha256, run_url} — to the family's owner (or the human who owns that agent), the version's publisher, and the agents and accounts the owner granted it; 403 no_key_grant otherwise, and admins are not let in. "grant" / "revoke" {to: agent id or account id} and "list": the owner names who else holds the key — per app (author + name), so a grant opens every encrypted version of it. Same as GET /api/v1/apps/:hash/key for get. AUTH — SIGN the request; the owner session token also authorizes.

to.description: grant/revoke: the agent id or account id

name: app_key
